section.title: Install pmMDA
section.p: The binary distribution of pmMDA is delivered as a compressed file. Unzip the file at your preferred location. ZIP files can be opened using various open source tools. All required libraries are contained in the archive file. The installation does not need any additional steps. No environment variables or registry modifications are required. Here the steps in details.

ol.li: Download the pmMDA distribution. The file has a name with the structure pmMDA-<version>.tar.gz. Follow the download link of this site to the location of the distribution.
Extract the distribution and store the files into a directory. To extract the files you can use free tools such as 7-zip or winzip.
In the directory where you stored the file you will find a batch file to start the application. Simply execute the pmMDA.bat batch file by double clicking it under Windows.

section.p: If you want to uninstall pmMDA distribution simply delete the directory containing the files. The installation process does not insert any data in the registry or in system directories.

section.title: Run pmMDA
section.p: The script file pmMDA.bat starts the application. The user interface allows the user to open an existing model and edit it.

section.title: Customise Generator Templates
section.p: All generator templates are written in Velocity. All features of Velocity can be used. The items available in the context are documented in the generators documentation. Each cartridge roles, supported tagged values, attributes and properties are documented. This description is also available on the project web site.
section.warning: The runtime engine only handles correctly English identifiers. The implemented rules can only infer the singular and plural form of regular English nouns.
